name: Opening Check-In
description: Confirm consent boundaries energy and timing before the session starts

name: Breathing Reset
description: A short paced breathing reset to lower intensity and restore steadiness

name: Creative Prompt
description: Choose a light creative prompt from a pre-approved list and respond together

name: Movement Break
description: A short movement break calibrated to current energy and comfort

name: Challenge Card
description: Draw a pre-approved challenge card with a clear opt-out and reset option

name: Story Exchange
description: Share a brief memory or value-based story with active listening

name: Skill Practice
description: Practice a harmless skill or micro-task with supportive feedback

name: Anticipation Timer
description: Use a short timer before revealing the next approved activity

name: High Energy Game
description: Play a fast-paced but bounded game with a stated stop signal

name: Comfort Mapping
description: Map what felt comfortable neutral or too intense for future planning

name: Hydration Cooldown
description: Pause for water stillness and a quick comfort check before continuing

name: Quiet Aftercare
description: Close with low-intensity care reflection and any requested decompression

name: Gratitude Note
description: Write or say one appreciative note and record any follow-up needs

name: Novelty Game
description: Use a random but approved prompt game with comfort check-ins

name: External Pressure Task
description: Example excluded task that is not available for generation

name: Boundary Violation Example
description: Example hard-limit placeholder that must never appear
